truthNotes: Construction: an open bypass of one smooth round gold-tone wire, the loop reaching left past the tiger eye, the band open between the ends; exactly two unmatched stones in slim irregular bezels (opaque banded golden-brown tiger eye, faceted transparent pale champagne crystal). No halo.
Ratios (verify.md): tiger eye / wire 7.0, tiger eye / ring width 0.39, ring width / height 1.23.
Colour: warm-neutral gold (hue 78) on a cooler deep sage (dE76 29-35).
Scale: about life size (16.8 Feed px/mm), so no 'Shown magnified' claim is printed.

Critic B: the tiger eye's face measures about 8.6-10.2 mm in the worn close ref, so the listing's 11.8 mm is probably the stone's length or diagonal; a face-width reading would overstate the visible stone by 15-35%. No mm is printed for the stone until products.md settles it.
Light logged as rendered: L2 asked, rendered L7-like soft key (both tries).
Weak point (B, desire 6): flat mid-sage under a soft key reads as a catalogue page; the Story's lower 750 px is dead sage floor.
